verdict.rationale: Whether a design tool's source is available under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Sketch's application source is published under any license. The sketch-document GitHub repo describes the file format, not the product's source, and the plugin JavaScript API and sketchtool CLI are extension and integration points, not open source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
